target_moa.text: Pertuzumab targets the extracellular dimerization domain (Subdomain II) of HER2, blocking ligand-dependent heterodimerization of HER2 with other HER family members (EGFR, HER3, HER4), thereby inhibiting intracellular signaling through the MAP kinase and PI3K pathways; it also mediates ADCC.

citations.quote: Pertuzumab targets the extracellular dimerization domain (Subdomain II) of the human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 protein (HER2) and, thereby, blocks ligand-dependent heterodimerization of HER2 with other HER family members, including EGFR, HER3 and HER4.
In addition, pertuzumab mediates antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC).
